messages:
lina (People Ops): Short notice: we're opening a 24-hour evidence-exception window for teams impacted by last night's outage. If your review form submitted on time but supporting docs were lost or failed to attach due to the outage, file an exception request by EOD tomorrow and we'll accept evidence only (no rating changes without manager approval). :warning:

tom (Eng Manager): Thanks. For affected ICs in my team, do I need to re-submit the entire review form or just the missing attachments?

lina (People Ops): Just attachments + a one-line manager confirmation. We will link the new attachments to the existing form via the receipt id. Do NOT resubmit the full form unless the rating needs to change (then contact priya first).

priya (People Ops): Upload here: https://internal.redwood.com/review-uploads-exception. Required filename and top-matter so our parser can reconcile: 

```
Filename pattern: EVID_<lastname>_<YYYYMMDD>_<mgrInit>.<ext>
Top lines (first page): reviewer_name | manager_name | original_form_ts | upload_ts | short_context
Example header: reviewer_name: Chen | manager_name: TM | original_form_ts: 2026-07-27T23:48:12Z | upload_ts: 2026-07-28T09:10:00Z | short_context: evidence from peer follow-up
```

jo (Manager): If attachments contain PII (client names, personal phones), should we redact before upload?

priya (People Ops): Yes — redact direct identifiers. If redaction harms review context, add a separate secure note to HR (we have KMS-backed private intake). Mention in the top-matter that PII was redacted and how to access originals if HR needs it.

tom (Eng Manager): Will late evidence be included in calibration pools? Also, will it change distribution calculations?

lina (People Ops): Inclusion: evidence submitted during the exception window with manager signoff will be included in the calibration packet. Distribution: we won't recalibrate distribution buckets unless a formal rating change is requested and approved. So evidence alone is considered supporting context, not a rating edit.

priya (People Ops): Small process note: exception uploads generate a receipt from intake-bot with UTC timestamp and a unique GUID. Save that receipt in your manager notes in case we need to trace. Example: intake-bot: receipt 9f4d-11ab uploaded 2026-07-28T11:05:33Z

intake-bot: upload accepted: receipt 9f4d-11ab for EVID_Chen_20260728_TM.pdf  queued to exception-triage.

jo (Manager): One of my reports is on LOA and their manager is out sick. Can a skip-level manager sign the confirmation?

lina (People Ops): Yes but escalate to priya first so we record the delegation. We require a one-line justification in the top-matter and HR will verify before attaching to calibration materials.

tom (Eng Manager): Any limits on file types or size? Got a large video recording from a customer call that supports the review.

priya (People Ops): Max 250MB per upload. For large media, preferred workflows: a) upload a 2-3 minute clipped excerpt + transcript, b) host original in secure share and include link + access instructions in top-matter. All media must be accompanied by manager confirmation.

lina (People Ops): We'll post a final status update once the exception-triage queue is processed. If you need an ad-hoc escalation, DM @priya. Thanks and apologies again for the outage. :pray:
